extra_quotes: first-principles calculations of the intrinsic spin Hall conductivity in the four all-inorganic compounds CsBX3 (B = Pb, Sn; X = Br, I) in the orthorhombic Pnma structure, using density functional theory with spin–orbit coupling and maximally localised Wannier functions.
Our calculations give the intrinsic spin Hall conductivity only. The extrinsic contributions from skew scattering and side jump at impurities, which depend on the sample [24], are not included.
The dependence on hole density is obtained in the rigid-band approximation, with the Fermi level moved through the bands of the undoped compound
The PBE band gap is below the measured gap, 0.48 eV compared with 1.3 eV for CsSnI3, and HSE06 gives 0.86 eV (Methods).
The structures considered here are static and at 0 K.
